ambient: The floor carries on at the speed of you.
A join in the floor comes up towards you and takes a long time about it.
description: A floor that's moving at the speed you walk, in the direction you walk, so that you're making excellent progress and the walls beside you're the same walls. Nobody has done this to you. It's how the floor is.
name: The Conveyor

looks: Moving. You can see the joins go by and there's one at your feet.
It has been running longer than the building it's in has been standing.
You step off it, and the part you step onto is moving too.
objects.name: the floor

looks: The same section of wall, keeping pace, faithfully.
There's a mark on it. There's the same mark ahead.
They're the walls of a place you were going to.
objects.name: the walls

weather: Moving air at exactly the speed of the floor, so it's still.
